patterns: what is shree devi institute of technology
response: Shree Devi Institute of Technology (SDIT), Kenjar Mangalore is a premier institution dedicated to excellence in engineering education and holistic development. Established in 2006, it offers a conducive learning environment that fosters innovation, creativity and leadership, and is affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University and recognized by AICTE.

patterns: what degrees does the college offer
response: Shree Devi Institute of Technology offers opportunities to students to pursue Management (MBA), Computer Application (MCA), Engineering (BE, M.Tech) and Research (PhD). The B.E programs include Computer Science & Engineering, CSE (Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning), Information Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering and Aeronautical Engineering.

patterns: which year was the college started
response: Shree Devi Institute of Technology was established in 2006 and has since emerged as a beacon of quality education.

patterns: is sdit affiliated to a university
which university is sdit affiliated to
what is the affiliation of sdit
response: Shree Devi Institute of Technology is affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University and recognized by AICTE, ensuring that its programs adhere to the highest academic standards and industry relevance.

patterns: what is the cet code of sdit
response: The CET code of Shree Devi Institute of Technology is E146. The PGCET codes are MBA - B281, MCA - C476 and M.Tech - T868.

patterns: what is the vision of the college
tell me the vision of sdit
response: The vision of Shree Devi Institute of Technology is to be an institution of academic excellence imparting technical and management education integrated with human values to face the social and environmental challenges.

patterns: what is the mission of the college
tell me the mission of sdit
response: The mission of SDIT is to disseminate quality education with student-centric learning methodologies, actively engage and encourage students, faculty and staff, mentor students and provide career development support, and impart education that transforms students and empowers them to emerge as professionals by inculcating entrepreneurial attitudes with social and ethical values.

response: Shree Devi Institute of Technology is located at Airport Road, Kenjar, Mangalore - 574142, Karnataka, India. You can contact the college at phone +91 (824) 2254104 or +91 (824) 2254102, and by mail at info@sdc.ac.in.

response: The SDIT campus includes state-of-the-art classrooms and well-equipped labs, a seminar hall, an open air theatre, sports and games facilities, a canteen and cafetaria, a recreational area, hostel, transportation and a library.

response: Beyond academics, Shree Devi Institute of Technology offers a vibrant campus life enriched with a wide range of co-curricular activities, sports, cultural events and community engagement initiatives. The college also has strong industry partnerships and a robust placement cell, collaborating with leading companies to provide internship opportunities, industrial visits and placement assistance.
